reuse.why: Folds the five per-provider link functions into one linkBankSyncAccount and three download functions into downloadBankSyncTransactions, reuses link.findOrCreateBank and syncAccount, and extracts clearAccountBankLink so the takeover reuses the unlink logic.

duplication.why: Removes large copy-paste; what remains is the provider name stated twice per route (in guardBankAccountLink and in the per-provider wrapper) and six near-identical account-id extractor lambdas.

placement.why: Link rules (closed check, holder lookup, refusal) live in accounts/link.ts and the download in sync.ts; the guard composing them is a wrapper defined inline among the app.method registrations in app.ts, which is acceptable but a little ad hoc.

scope.why: Beyond the four requests it rewrites all provider link and download functions, which incidentally changes Akahu's sync-event tables and GoCardless's official_name fallback.

maintainability.why: Adding a provider is now a few lines and the link rules are in one guard, though the guard-plus-wrapper double registration and unannounced behaviour drift need review.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link routes go through guardBankAccountLink and linkBankSyncAccount; unlink reuses clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated provider code is removed and shared rather than reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains a fileId parameter for Pluggy's real variation; downloadBankSyncTransactions takes extraBody/extraHeaders for Enable Banking/Pluggy; no special-case branches inside the shared helpers and every link route uses the guard.
